rrhh.ayuda: Filter and open a pending application. Check its requirements before admitting or rejecting it. After the final list, add the applicant using the list reference.
rrhh.denegada: Your current access does not allow you to view these applications. If you should have access, contact the permissions manager.
rrhh.error: Applications could not be loaded. Select Retry. If the problem continues, contact IT support.
rrhh.error_decision: The decision could not be confirmed. Select Confirm again with the same details. If the problem continues, contact IT support.
rrhh.conflicto: The application has changed since you opened it. Refresh the list and check its status before deciding.
rrhh.falta_acta: The applicant cannot be added to the pool yet. Check that the final list and its evidence are available, then try again.
rrhh.regla_incompatible: The admission rules have changed. Refresh the list and review the application again.
rrhh.evidencia_invalida: The final list reference was not recognised. Check it and confirm entry into the pool again.
rrhh.plazo_cerrado: The application period for this recruitment process has ended. Refresh the list and check the application status.
rrhh.vacio: There are no applications matching these filters. Change the status or clear the recruitment process filter to search again.
rrhh.requisitos_pendientes: Some mandatory requirements are not verified. Review the documents before admitting the applicant.
rrhh.motivos_no_disponibles: No rejection reasons are available for this application. Contact the person responsible for admission rules.
rrhh.admitida_a_convocatoria: The application has been admitted to the recruitment process. Entry into the pool awaits the final list.
rrhh.incorporada: The applicant has been added to the pool.
